questions.title: Spot the Non-Pillar
questions.description: The four widely taught pillars of object-oriented programming are Encapsulation, Abstraction, Inheritance and Polymorphism. Which of the following is NOT one of them?

questions.title: Encapsulation Core Idea
questions.description: Encapsulation in Java is best described as:
questions.Option1: Bundling data and the methods that operate on it into one class while restricting direct access to the data
questions.Option2: Allowing one class to acquire the fields and methods of another class
questions.Option3: Writing a single method with several different parameter lists
questions.Option4: Splitting a program into multiple source files

questions.title: Abstraction Focus
questions.description: Abstraction in object-oriented programming focuses on:
questions.Option1: Exposing only the essential features of an object while hiding its internal details
questions.Option2: Revealing every internal variable to the outside world
questions.Option3: Copying the state of one object into another
questions.Option4: Converting primitive values into objects automatically

questions.title: is-a with extends
questions.description: When a program writes class Car extends Vehicle, the relationship between Car and Vehicle is best described as:
questions.Option4: Car uses-a Vehicle only while running

questions.title: Blueprint and Instance
questions.description: Which statement correctly describes a class and an object?
questions.Option1: A class is a runtime instance; an object is its source code
questions.Option2: A class and an object are two names for exactly the same thing
questions.Option3: An object can be created in Java without any class
questions.Option4: A class is a blueprint; an object is an instance created from that blueprint

questions.title: Role of the new Keyword
questions.description: In Java, the new keyword is used to:
questions.Option3: Create a new object in memory and return a reference to it

questions.title: Default Field Values Preview
questions.description: What does this program print when none of the fields are explicitly initialized?
questions.Option4: It throws a NullPointerException at runtime

questions.title: Polymorphism in One Line
questions.description: Polymorphism in object-oriented programming mainly allows:
questions.Option1: A class to contain only static methods
questions.Option2: Two variables to share the same memory location
questions.Option3: A program to run without a main method
questions.Option4: One method name or one reference to take many forms depending on the object it works with

questions.title: has-a with a Field
questions.description: A class Car contains the field: private Engine engine; What is the relationship between Car and Engine best described as?

questions.title: Abstraction in Action
questions.description: A class Calculator offers the method convertToCelsius(double f). Code that uses Calculator simply calls the method and gets the answer without ever seeing the formula written inside it. Which pillar makes this possible?
questions.Option4: Abstraction, because the implementation detail is hidden behind a simple method call
